subject: Request: Cross-region term stability for OliveBridge expansion
messages:
From: Jordan Miller <jmiller@olivebridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing stability ask for global rollout

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at OliveBridge is ready to move forward, but there's one big commercial question we need to resolve before committing: as we expand into APAC next year, our procurement team is pushing for a regional price stability guarantee for multi-year terms. Specifically they want a region-blind price lock for the duration of the term (they\'re worried about currency-driven price drift and differing regional SKUs).

High-level ask: would Redwood consider a 36-month price lock with an uplift cap not to exceed 7% per year and a renewal protection clause (no automatic price increases at renewal without 90 days notice and mutual written consent)? We\'ll share forecast and estimated consumption (attached).

If possible, can you escalate to the right team — we\'d like to have a term sheet by mid-December so our board can sign off on the expansion.

Attachments: forecast_q4.xlsx (forecast by region, v1)

Best,
Jordan Miller
Head of Procurement, OliveBridge
jmiller@olivebridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@olivebridge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing stability ask for global rollout

Jordan — thanks for the clarity and for the forecast. I\'m looping in Deal Desk (Vivek) and Sales Ops (Rishi) to prepare a proposal. Quick answers up front:

- We can consider a 36-month term with a price lock, but it will require a minimum committed ARR level and a regional volume threshold to avoid exposure from FX and local infrastructure costs.
- Uplift cap: 7%/yr is in the ballpark; we typically push for CPI or a CPI+ floor.
- Renewal protection: we can offer a non-unilateral renewal increase clause, but legal needs to define the exact mechanics (notice window, mutual consent language, and exceptions for material taxonomy changes).

Next steps: Vivek, Rishi — please prepare a short risk summary and recommended guardrails (commit levels, termination triggers, audit rights) and a proposed amendment. Jordan, we\'ll aim to get an internal decision this week and follow up with a draft term amendment.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Dec 2027 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: REQUEST: Exec sign-off for cross-region price lock (OliveBridge / DB-2027-0897)

Team — OliveBridge (prospect) is requesting a 3-year cross-region price lock with a 7%/yr uplift cap and renewal protection language. They\'re expanding into APAC and need pricing certainty. I\'m asking for an exec-level approval because the request deviates from standard regional pricing and includes a clause that could limit our ability to adjust rates for regional cost changes.

Summary (proposal):
- Term: 36 months
- Price lock: fixed per-unit price by usage tier; locked across NA + APAC for duration
- Uplift cap: maximum 7% per full contract year; any increase must be applied uniformly across regions
- Renewal protection: no unilateral increase at renewal without 90 days notice and mutual written consent; exceptions for tax or regulatory changes
- Commit: Min ARR $1.2M over term; regional minimum volumes (see attached regional_volume_table.csv)
- Rights: Redwood retains audit rights to verify consumption; failure to meet commit triggers overage billing at prevailing rates

Risks / impact:
- FX/regulatory differential exposure if APAC infra costs spike (mitigated by commit floors + audit)
- Limits on reactive price adjustments during geopolitical cost shocks
- Potential precedent for other expansion deals

Request:
- Kimberly / Marissa — legal & finance sign-off to allow the deviation with the proposed mitigations
- Vivek — prepare the term amendment for DocuSign if approved

Attachments: deal_summary.pdf, regional_volume_table.csv

Thanks,
Mina
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 14:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: REQUEST: Exec sign-off for cross-region price lock (OliveBridge / DB-2027-0897)

Team — I\'ve reviewed the proposal and have the following comments before I can sign off:

1) Uplift mechanism: change from "7% absolute cap" to "min(CPI+2%, 7%)" to protect Redwood from high inflation in target markets.
2) Renewal protection: we can agree to the 90-day notice + mutual consent, but require an additional clause to allow a market-adjustment mechanism in case of material tariff or data sovereignty costs.
3) Audit & compliance: add explicit data residency audit language and a one-time operational review within the first 12 months (to validate regional cost assumptions).
4) Termination: include a limited carve for force majeure/geopolitical events allowing either party to renegotiate within 30 days.

If Finance (Marissa) confirms the minimum ARR and the exposure model, I can provide conditional legal approval. I\'m attaching inline the redline suggestions and will ask Legal Ops to prepare a clean amendment after finance confirms numbers.

-Kimberly
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: FINAL: Finance sign-off & conditional approval (OliveBridge / DB-2027-0897)

Mina — Finance has completed the exposure analysis against the regional_volume_table.csv and we\'re comfortable with the proposed guardrails, provided the following conditions are included in the amendment:

1) Minimum committed ARR $1.2M over 36 months confirmed.
2) Uplift to be applied per Kimberly\'s suggested language (min(CPI+2%, 7%)).
3) Annual reconciliation: OliveBridge must provide audited usage reports within 45 days of each anniversary; over/under consumption reconciled within 60 days.
4) Audit rights and one-time operational review (12 months) included.
5) Exit carve for material regulatory or tariff changes (30-day negotiation window).

With those conditions, Finance APPROVES the deviation and we authorize Deal Desk to execute the amendment. Approval token: MAR-227 (finance sign-off id).

Vivek — please incorporate the clauses and send the amendment via DocuSign. Jordan — we\'ll target to have the signed amendment and countersigned SOW by Dec 20.

Attachments: approval_sheet_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
